name: Robert W Crown Memorial SB
description: Robert W. Crown Memorial State Beach in Alameda has 2.5 miles of bay beach bordered by lawns, picnic areas, and a bike trail, plus the Crab Cove Visitor Center. It is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District.
fullDescription: Robert W. Crown Memorial State Beach in Alameda has 2.5 miles of bay beach bordered by lawns, picnic areas, and a bike trail, plus the Crab Cove Visitor Center. It is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District.
whatTheyOffer:
- Sandy bay beach for swimming, windsurfing, kiteboarding, and kayaking
- Picnic areas, lawns, and a paved bike trail
- Crab Cove Visitor Center with free naturalist programs
- Open 5am to 10pm; dogs allowed on lawns and paved paths only, not on the beach
howToGetIt:
Parking: $5 per vehicle (card only at the pay station). Walking or biking in is free.

Contact the East Bay Regional Park District at 510-562-PARK (7275) for programs and current conditions.
keywords: Crown Memorial, state beach, Alameda, beach, bay views, picnic, windsurfing, crab cove
